entries.title: Psalms 114:1
segments: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

entries.title: Psalms 114:2
segments: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

entries.title: Psalms 114:3
segments: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.

entries.title: Psalms 114:4
segments: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.

entries.title: Psalms 114:5
segments: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?

entries.title: Psalms 114:6
segments: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
segments: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,

entries.title: Psalms 114:8
segments: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
